title: A look-alike: two clouds
problem_line: The subject vanishes in the walkway; then someone in the same red shirt steps out of its far end. Is that them?

beats.caption: Designated subject in a red shirt and jeans; the drone follows on its own.
Lost in the covered walkway. One particle cloud flows north along Oak Street.
A second red shirt steps out of the north end. A second hypothesis: maybe that is the subject.
Two clouds, two colours. D12 picks the viewpoint that keeps both in view.
The look-alike jogs off east. Their cloud is in the open, so the drone checks it first.
Nobody there: the belief moves back to the subject's cloud on Oak Street.
The subject is found. The drone never followed the look-alike; a person confirms who is who.

success_line: Two hypotheses instead of one merged identity; the route covered both; a person confirmed the right one.
